topic: Draymond Green's teammate gets into a scuffle and Draymond is caught smiling proudly on the sidelines.

hook.first_words: Draymond Green is famous for all the chaos he brings on the court, but most of his Warriors teammates usually don't act like that.
hook.first_frame: Draymond Green in uniform standing over a fallen player on the court.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: DRAYMOND GREEN IS FAMOUS FOR ALL THE CHAOS HE BRINGS ON THE COURT

shots.shows: Draymond Green stepping over a fallen player on the basketball court.
Basketball players grappling and holding each other back in a scuffle.
Players shoving during a game in front of an arena crowd.
Pat Spencer confronting and headbutting an opposing player.
Trayce Jackson-Davis stepping in to defend his teammate.
Draymond Green smiling and clapping on the sidelines while wearing a towel.

ending.last_frame: Draymond Green smiling and clapping on the sidelines.

script: Draymond Green is famous for all the chaos he brings on the court, but most of his Warriors teammates usually don't act like that. So when things started getting heated with the Rockets, everyone was shocked when Pat Spencer actually fought back and headbutted Sengun. And it didn't stop there, because Trayce Jackson-Davis stepped in too to defend his teammate. But the funny part was when the broadcast immediately cut to Draymond, who looked way too proud of what he was watching.
retention_tricks: payoff ending showing the reaction shot
what_makes_it_work: Engaging narrative arc moving from player reputation to teammate escalation to the funny final reaction.
Pacing matches the fast action of basketball brawls.
Strong visual punchline with Draymond Green's proud smile on the bench.
